title: Exhaustion from nights listening to New Orleans musicians
summary: He worked until 3 a.m. then went to hear musicians like Jimmie Noone, lost weight and rest, and left as Chicago business collapsed.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: The Dreamland, about how long were you there, you long did you stay?
Well I first stayed, I guess, about three months, I guess three months.

And it was just absolutely impossible to stay there at the time. And I was losing a lot of rest, I was losing weight I was down to, I guess, about 115 pounds, because I worked a full -- 3:00 o'clock in the morning and then go hear the musicians over at the Sunset and then I'd go across the street to the -- what was the name of that night club, I forget, now. Then I'd go here -- go there. I was listening to those New Orleans musicians so much, Jimmy Noon, and all of
them till I wasn't getting any rest, and I was losing a lot of rest.
And it was, the thing, the bottom just fell out of everything in Chicago at that time.
